body.name: e
body.def: Under the full-support design \(P\circ X^{-1}=\lambda\), \(e\) denotes the unique continuous representative, whenever one exists, of the \(\lambda\)-almost-everywhere conditional-probability class \(x\mapsto P(A=1\mid X=x)\). Full support makes every continuous, and hence every Hölder-continuous, version unique; every pointwise Hölder or box condition on \(e\) refers to this representative.
